description: This file contains utility functions for benchmarking and tensor operations in a PyTorch project, including tensor transposition, memory fitting checks, tensor generation, precision setting, and random number generation within power-of-two ranges.

methods.name: tuple[bool,bool] transpose_tensors(p_transpose_both: float = 0.05)
methods.description: Randomly determines whether to transpose tensors on the left, right, both, or neither, based on a given probability.

methods.name: Any fits_in_memory(dtype: Any, m: int, k: int, n: int)
methods.description: Checks if the product of tensor sizes and itemsize fits within a quarter of the GPU's total memory.

methods.name: tuple[Any,Any] get_mm_tensors( m: int, k: int, n: int, transpose_left: bool, transpose_right: bool, dtype_left: Any, dtype_right: Any, )
methods.description: Generates a pair of random tensors, optionally transposed, suitable for matrix multiplication benchmarks.

methods.name: None set_precision(dtype: Any, p_float32_prec_highest: float = 0.8)
methods.description: Sets the floating point precision for matrix multiplication in PyTorch based on tensor dtype and a specified probability.

methods.name: int get_random_between_pow2(min_power2: int, max_power2: int)
methods.description: Returns a random integer between two powers of two, inclusive, with some additional logic to determine the range.

ctags.name: fits_in_memory
ctags.pattern: /^def fits_in_memory(dtype: Any, m: int, k: int, n: int) -> Any:$/
ctags.signature: (dtype: Any, m: int, k: int, n: int)

ctags.signature: ( m: int, k: int, n: int, transpose_left: bool, transpose_right: bool, dtype_left: Any, dtype_right: Any, )
